resources.string: 1. Keep patient calm and seated.\n2. Loosen tight clothes.\n3. Give aspirin (if available and not allergic).
1. Remember FAST: Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to call ambulance.\n2. Keep them calm.
1. Sit them upright.\n2. Loosen tight clothing.\n3. Use inhaler if they have one.
1. Apply firm, direct pressure with a clean cloth.\n2. Elevate the wounded area if possible.
1. Do not move the person unless in immediate danger.\n2. Stop any severe bleeding.
1. Cool the burn under cool running water for 10-15 mins.\n2. Do NOT apply ice or ointments.\n3. Cover with a clean cloth.
1. DO NOT touch the person if they are still connected to power.\n2. Turn off the power source.\n3. Check breathing and start CPR if needed.
1. Find out what was swallowed.\n2. Do NOT induce vomiting unless told by a professional.
1. Check if breathing.\n2. If breathing, roll to their side.\n3. If not breathing, start CPR.
1. Remove excess clothing.\n2. Sponge with lukewarm water.\n3. Keep hydrated.
